research_findings: Waitlist signup in `src/app/actions/waitlist.ts` had a TODO to implement rate limiting.
Upstash Redis and Ratelimit packages are necessary to properly rate limit Waitlist API usage and were installed.
features_improved: Waitlist signup (`joinWaitlist`) now includes an IP-based rate limit via Upstash Redis sliding window.
new_features_added: Added configurable Upstash-backed rate limiter utility that degrades gracefully when not configured.
next_steps_for_next_run: Evaluate the necessity of rate limiting in other Server Actions.
